description: This file contains the implementation of the ClusterMembershipService class, which manages cluster membership snapshots, updates, and the process of handling membership changes in an Orleans runtime environment. It includes methods for refreshing membership data, processing updates, and lifecycle participation.

classes.name: ClusterMembershipService
classes.description: Implements cluster membership management, including update processing, snapshot handling, and lifecycle participation.

methods.name: ClusterMembershipService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the membership service with necessary dependencies.

methods.name: CurrentSnapshot
methods.description: Property returning the current cluster membership snapshot.

methods.name: MembershipUpdates
methods.description: Property exposing an asynchronous stream of membership snapshot updates.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Triggers an asynchronous refresh of the membership data to a specific version.

methods.name: TryKill
methods.description: Attempts to remove a silo from the cluster by its address.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Background method that processes membership updates and publishes snapshots.

methods.name: ILifecycleParticipant<ISiloLifecycle>.Participate
methods.description: Method to participate in the lifecycle stages of the silo, starting and stopping update processing.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes resources used by the service.
